name: INHUBBER
description_en:
Inhubber is a hosted contract-management platform combining agreement storage, deadline tracking, AI analysis, tasks and electronic signatures. Its current site describes organisational structures spanning holdings, subsidiaries and departments, rather than only a personal signing inbox.

The package boundary matters: Basic emphasizes files, dates and signatures; Standard adds AI analysis and full-text search; Professional adds individual workflows, APIs and integrations. German hosting is a vendor statement in the public material, not an independently inspected deployment.
description_zh:
Inhubber 是托管合同管理平台，结合协议存储、日期跟踪、AI 分析、任务及电子签署。当前官网描述覆盖控股公司、子公司和部门的组织结构，而不仅是个人签署收件箱。

套餐边界很重要：Basic 侧重文件、日期及签署；Standard 增加 AI 分析与全文搜索；Professional 增加自定义流程、API 和集成。公开材料中的德国托管属于厂商说明，并非本文独立检查的部署。

core_features.explanation_en: Set lead times for notices, payments and renewal reminders.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为通知、付款和续约提醒设置提前量。

core_features.explanation_en: Organize contracts by teams and entities with access controls depending on package.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按团队及实体整理合同，访问控制取决于套餐。

core_features.name_zh: 按套餐提供 AI 与 API
core_features.explanation_en: Standard lists AI analysis; Professional lists APIs and custom integrations.
core_features.explanation_zh: Standard 列有 AI 分析，Professional 列有 API 及自定义集成。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.en: A logistics group could store supplier agreements by subsidiary, assign responsible staff and set reminders before cancellation deadlines. Inhubber documents configurable lead times and notifications for renewals, notices and payments. Start with a renewal date, its notice period and one reassigned owner; check the actual task and recipient after the handoff. The marketing claim that no deadline is missed is not a measured guarantee.
sections.zh: 物流集团可按子公司保存供应商协议，指定负责人，并在取消截止日前设置提醒。Inhubber 文档描述可配置提前量，以及续约、通知和付款提醒。可先准备续约日期、通知期和一次负责人变更，交接后核对实际任务和收件人。“不漏截止日”的营销说法不是实测保证。

sections.title_en: Count files, documents and integration needs separately
sections.title_zh: 分别核对合同文件、文档及集成需求
sections.en: Basic lists 50 contract files per user and 1,000 documents, alongside unlimited eSignatures, mass import/export and custom fields. Those are different units, not 1,000 contracts per user. Standard explicitly adds AI analysis, full-text search, workspaces and granular access. Professional adds bespoke processes, API/custom connections and ERP/CRM integration on demand. Confirm the operative allowances and signature type in a quote.
sections.zh: Basic 列出每用户 50 个合同文件及 1,000 份文档，并有不限量签署、批量导入导出和自定义字段。这些单位不同，不能改写为每用户 1,000 份合同。Standard 明确增加 AI 分析、全文搜索、工作空间及细粒度访问；Professional 增加定制流程、API／自定义连接和按需 ERP／CRM 集成。应在报价中确认实际额度和签署类型。

sections.title_en: Keep simple and qualified signatures distinct
sections.title_zh: 区分简单签署和合格签署
sections.en: The pricing comparison distinguishes simple electronic signature from Qualified Electronic Signature using identity verification through partner Nect. An unlimited-signature package statement does not establish an unlimited allowance for every verification service. Decide the required signature method before procurement, and confirm whether signers, identity checks or external providers introduce extra conditions. No signature or identity verification was performed.
sections.zh: 定价对照区分简单电子签署与通过合作伙伴 Nect 验证身份的合格电子签署。套餐“不限量签署”不等于每种验证服务都不限量。采购前应确定所需签署方法，再确认签署人、身份核验及外部服务的额外条件。本文未实际签署或验证身份。

sections.title_en: Request pricing for the chosen commercial model
sections.en: The official page asks for a tailored offer for Basic, Standard and Professional and offers monthly and annual views. It also says per-contract pricing is available. No numeric payable amount was verified. Request users, contract-file volume, document/storage limits, AI, workflows, qualified-signature services, migration and integration work in the quote; do not compare seat and per-contract offers as if their units match.
sections.zh: 官方对 Basic、Standard、Professional 提供定制询价，并有月付与年付视图，还说明可按合同计价。未核实数字金额。报价应列明用户、合同文件量、文档／存储上限、AI、流程、合格签署服务、迁移及集成工作；不能把按用户和按合同报价当作相同单位比较。

sections.en: Inhubber is relevant where many departments need coordinated deadlines and contract visibility. A team that needs offline files or only one signature should clarify that requirement first. Start with representative contracts and permission roles, compare AI outputs with the originals and check an exported record. Hosting, encryption and certification claims need applicable contractual evidence; no licence, recovery commitment or independent security assessment was completed.
sections.zh: 多个部门需要协调日期和合同可见性时，Inhubber 值得评估。需要离线文件或仅一次签署的团队，应先澄清需求。可从代表性合同和权限角色开始，把 AI 输出与原件对照，并检查导出记录。托管、加密和认证主张仍需适用合同证据；本文未完成许可、恢复承诺或独立安全评估。
